info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Collateral Asset Modification API
info.description: The Collateral Asset Modification API enables users to update details of existing collateral assets in the financial management system. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate asset records, facilitating effective risk management and compliance. Typical consumers include financial institutions and asset managers who require real-time updates to asset information. By providing this endpoint, organizations can ensure their collateral asset data is current and reflect any necessary changes promptly.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific collateral asset identified by its unique resource identifier (RES-100045). Ensure that the request contains all necessary fields to reflect the desired updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to modify the collateral asset identified by the specified resource. It should contain the updated properties as defined in the schema.
